question.text: Under CSCRF, who must be appointed to oversee the cyber security program at a QRTA (Qualified RTA)?

explanation.text: The Logic: Per workbook pp.76-77, CSCRF applies to QRTAs (those servicing more than 2 crore folios) and requires the appointment of a Chief Information Security Officer (CISO) to oversee the cyber security program. The Trap: The MD is part of the Incident Response Team but is not the dedicated cyber security officer. External consultants can advise but cannot replace the mandated in-house CISO. The CSCRF requirement is specific to QRTAs, not to every RTA. Note: The CISO appointment under CSCRF is a QRTA-level obligation linked to the 2 crore folio threshold; smaller RTAs fall outside the CSCRF scope.
